headNote: Fable reviewed 25e1c031. Root diffed the four-file test/receipt amendment and accepted 1b4fb6bf. No second independent full-head review is claimed.

postReviewAmendment.scope: F1-F5 in one test/receipt-only amendment; zero counted lines, no new files, product and units.json unchanged.

fixes.F1: Five wrong mints followed by SQLite reopen and a new service: correct password is throttled before KDF; expiry permits mint. MUT-14 is caught by this row.
fixes.F2: Four wrong mints followed by success clear failedAttempts and lockedUntilMs; a second sequence still succeeds. MUT-15 is caught by this row.
fixes.F3: A wrong-password in-flight mint plus a refused concurrent request records exactly one failure. MUT-18 is caught by the amended row.
fixes.F4: Refused before any KDF or credential interpretation. Next apiResolver JSON-parses up to 8 kB before the handler runs; literal pre-read enforcement is deferred to the Root decision in CF-LSC1-6.
fixes.F5: RED receipt is ASCII-only through JSON Unicode escapes; parsed content and original runtime proof are unchanged.

postReviewAmendment.historicalProof: The original 44-fail/16-pass RED and initial ten mutants refer to the reviewed test revision. Current test hashes and GREEN/regression/typecheck below include F1-F3; the three reviewer mutants provide their additional RED proof. No original baseline RED rerun is claimed.

items.rulingText: - CF-LSC1-1: the window is a per-module singleton; revisit if a second route appears.
items.reviewerText: - CF-LSC1-1 (-> LSC-2OP / LSC-2 / any later route): the mint and operator windows live on the LocalSeatCredentialService module singleton; Next bundles API routes separately and dev HMR re-instantiates modules, so a second route importing the service may not share the window. Keep every seat action on /api/multiplayer/auth/local-seats, or prove sharing with a two-route test before adding one.

items.rulingText: - CF-LSC1-2: no E2E bypass, for LSC-2P.
items.reviewerText: - CF-LSC1-2 (-> LSC-2P): AttemptWindow has no E2E bypass (unlike rateLimit). Playwright scenarios must stay within 10 mints and 5 operator writes per server-minute or advance time; the explicit ttlMs <= 1 h is the expiry seam (CF-LSC0-14 resolved that way).

items.rulingText: - CF-LSC1-3: client handling of 429 vs 401 -> LSC-2.
items.reviewerText: - CF-LSC1-3 (-> LSC-2): the client must distinguish 429 LOCAL_SEAT_THROTTLED (Retry-After; lockout, window or in-flight) from 401 LOCAL_SEAT_DENIED, surface Retry-After, and never auto-retry a mint in a loop (every attempt consumes the shared window; D14 accepted same-host denial).

items.rulingText: - CF-LSC1-4: re-check scope parity when U101a lands.
items.reviewerText: - CF-LSC1-4 (-> U101a / LSC-2, whichever lands second): "same payload, scope and verifier semantics as the primary mint route at that head" is proven for the unscoped head; when token.ts or the socket verifier gains required scopes, local-seats.ts / LocalSeatCredentialService.mint must change in the same head and the P5-style parity row re-run.

items.rulingText: - CF-LSC1-5: the H2 guard and limiter stay route-local for B15.
items.reviewerText: - CF-LSC1-5 (-> B15-AUTH-ORIGIN / B15-AUTH-LIMIT): isLocalRequest() and AttemptWindow are route-local by contract; B15 may lift the shape but LSC-1 discharges nothing for token.ts, unlock.ts or security.ts (blob ids unchanged at this head: token.ts e50fceca5, unlock.ts 3dd359466, security.ts a68e79e09, auth.ts 4a38dd1a7, server.js 7ce8627c3).

items.rulingText: - CF-LSC1-6: literal vs handler-level "before reading the body".
items.reviewerText: - CF-LSC1-6 (-> Root / LSC-2OP admission): decide whether H2's "before reading the body" is to be literal (bodyParser: false + bounded manual read after the guard, about 15 counted lines) or handler-level as implemented (L2); record the decision in the LSC-1 review receipt.

- CF-LSC1-7 (-> LSC-2OP UI): a 409 GENERATION_CONFLICT carries currentGeneration; a 409 OPERATION_MISMATCH carries nothing; both must refresh the form and mint a fresh operation id (CF-LSC1S-4 unchanged). Ghost membership and the operator-can-impersonate disclosure remain LSC-2OP's (D14).
